description: Publication tables transcribed from the provided 196 reference PDF and cross-checked against saved aggregate summaries. This file is not a new inference run.

interpretation.final: Final-answer submission; correctness is scored separately.
interpretation.function_accuracy: Exact match to a reference code-location path and function name, divided by all assigned attempts.
interpretation.parser_relaxed: Post-hoc diagnostic condition; archived repair code additionally contains trailing-comma removal.
interpretation.native_xml: Separate comparison with a different output notation and prompted tool list.
interpretation.tool_cap: Tool budget exhaustion; underlying cause is not identified by the terminal label alone.
interpretation.aggregate_comparison: Condition-level differences do not establish per-attempt state transitions.
